comparison.objective: Exercise a TPR valve and report whether it is obstructed versus tune a shock absorber to an acceptable response.
comparison.physical_skill: Quarter-turn a square knob against a possible stop and place a condition tag versus recessed-key use, counterhold, fine collar tuning, relocking, and repeated impact cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Knob moved at least 15° while seated and tag placed on the correct condition pad versus two safe stops within stroke/energy limits and no lock drift.
comparison.reason: Physical diagnostic rotation is shared only generically; pr-1246 classifies a binary obstruction, while the candidate performs continuous calibration plus retention verification.
